tools.name: search_menu
tools.description: Search menu items of Japanese restaurant chains and stores, and packaged foods of Japanese food makers, and get their nutrition facts. Queries that return no results are counted anonymously (the query text and chain only) to decide which chains to add. query matches item name, size, category, genre

tools.name: sum_items
tools.description: Add up nutrition for a set of items (a meal, a day) using ids from search_menu. Nutrients that some items do not publish are reported in incomplete, because their total is an underestimate.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List the restaurant chains, stores and packaged-food makers covered (makers have type: packaged_food_maker), with item counts (current items only), which nutrients each chain publishes and when the data was fetched. query filters by chain name and also returns each chain's source document URL.

tools.name: request_missing
tools.description: Tell the site operator that a restaurant chain or menu item is missing. Use only after search_menu / list_chains could not find it AND the user actually wanted it. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_menu, list_chains · Private data: list_chains · Public sink: search_menu, sum_items, request_missing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_menu, list_chains · Private data: list_chains · Public sink: search_menu, sum_items, request_missing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
